chunks: 368- 一群学者传述于我们，出自阿布·穆罕默德·塔拉克巴里，转述阿布·阿里·穆罕默德·本·哈玛姆说：

Al-Shari'i was known as Abu Muhammad. Harun said: I think his name was Hasan, and he was among the companions of Abul Hasan Ali ibn Muhammad, and then after him among the companions of Hasan ibn Ali, peace be upon them. He is the first to claim a position that Allah did not assign to him and he was not qualified for it. He lied about Allah and His Proofs (Huj Allah and His Proofs (Hujjah), peace be upon them, and attributed to them what is not worthy of them and they are free from it. The Shia cursed him and turned away from him, and the Imam's decree (Tawqi') came out cursing him and declaring freedom from him. Harun said: Then words of disbelief and sacrilege were uttered by him. He said: And all these claimants, their lie is first directed at the Imam, claiming that they are his representatives, calling the weak to believe in them through such claims. Then the matter escalates for them to the claims of self-deification (Hallajiyah), as became famous from Abu Ja'far al-Shalmaghani and his like, peace be upon them all, with the constant curses of Allah upon them.

key_terms.أَبُو الْحَسَنِ عَلِيُّ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ: 阿布·哈桑·阿里·本·穆罕默德
key_terms.أَبُو جَعْفَرٍ الشَّلْمَغَانِيُّ: 阿布·贾法尔·沙尔马甘尼
key_terms.الْإِلْحَادُ: 伊尔哈德（亵渎/偏离真理）
key_terms.الْحَلَّاجِيَّةُ: 哈贾吉耶（与阿尔-哈贾吉相关的自我神化教义）

ai.seo_question: 沙里伊是谁，为什么什叶派诅咒他？
ai.summary: 这段来自图西《隐遁之书》的圣训指出，沙里伊是篡夺非真主所赐灵性地位的典型伪称者，因此被伊玛目们绝交（塔乌鲁德）。它展示了“异乡人/伪称者”的演变轨迹，即最初的代理权宣称逐渐升级为自我神化，这一模式在后来的阿尔-沙尔马甘尼等人物身上得到了显著体现。
